column1: # Per-file ceilings on implementation lines (#48). Checked by
# These are NOT targets. Every value is today's measurement rounded up to
# the next 50, which gives an ordinary change room to breathe while making
# sustained growth impossible to add without noticing: the moment a file
# crosses its ceiling, CI fails and the only way through is to edit this
# file in the same pull request — where a reviewer sees it.
# Raising a ceiling is a legitimate thing to do. Doing it silently is not,
# Lower a ceiling whenever a file shrinks below it. `src/ui.rs` used to be
# the one that matters -- 3,352 implementation lines against a ceiling of
# the same number, no headroom at all, holding rendering, state
# transitions, async task management and `EntityInputHandler` together.
# ceilings are the measurements afterwards, lowered rather than carried
# over: a ceiling kept at the old number would not notice the file
# A new file must be added here before it can be committed — an unlisted
# file is a failure, not a pass, so this cannot be sidestepped by adding
